message.content:
Yes, you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta. The city’s Department of Public Safety handles noise complaints, and you can also use the 311 service to report them.

**How to file a noise complaint in Atlanta**

| Method | How to do it | Contact |
|--------|--------------|---------|
| **Online** | Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website and use the “Report a Problem” portal. Search for “noise complaint” or “public safety.” | https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 |
| **Phone** | Call 311 from within Atlanta or 404‑727‑3111 from outside the city. | 404‑727‑3111 |
| **In person** | Go to your local police precinct or the City Hall’s public safety office. | City Hall: 55 Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Atlanta, GA 30303 |
| **Mail** | Send a written complaint to the City of Atlanta, Department of Public Safety, Attn: Noise Complaint Unit. | 55 Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Atlanta, GA 30303 |

When filing, provide:

* Your name and contact information (optional but helpful)
* The address or location of the noise source
* Date(s) and time(s) when the noise occurred
* A description of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs)

The city typically investigates complaints within a few days and may issue warnings or citations if the noise violates local ordinances. If you’re dealing with a recurring issue, keep a log of dates and times to support your case.
